reading.title: Planning Our Picnic
reading.purpose: Learn how a class plans a picnic using joining words.
paras: Our class will have a picnic unless it rains. Although the sky is gray, we are hopeful. We will pack sandwiches and also fruit instead of cake.
While we eat, we can play games. We will stay until two o'clock. Everyone is coming except Tom. However, Tom will send a card.

qs.q: The class will have a picnic unless it rains. What does unless mean?
qs.why: The picnic will happen if it does not rain.

qs.q: Who is not coming to the picnic?
qs.why: The reading says everyone is coming except Tom.

qs.q: What will they bring instead of cake?
qs.why: They will pack fruit instead of cake.

reading.retellFrame: We will have a picnic unless ___.
